#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n; // consume unused int
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int max = 0, len = 0, cnt = 0;
    bool paren = false, lastLetter = false;
    for (char ch : s) {
        bool letter = (ch > 96 && ch < 123) || (ch > 64 && ch < 91);
        if (letter) {
            if (paren && !lastLetter) cnt++;
            if (!paren) len++;
            if (len > max) max = len;
            lastLetter = true;
        } else if (ch == '_') {
            lastLetter = false;
            if (len > max) max = len;
            len = 0;
        } else if (ch == '(') {
            lastLetter = false;
            paren = true;
            if (len > max) max = len;
            len = 0;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            paren = false;
            lastLetter = false;
            if (len > max) max = len;
            len = 0;
        }
    }
    cout << max << " " << cnt << endl;
    return 0;
}
